theme.description: Page appearance. Every key is optional.

mode.description: Default for users who haven't used the theme button. auto follows the OS. Default: auto

tileSize.description: Minimum tile size in px; tiles grow to fit the longest word in any app name. Default: 100

accent.description: CSS colour for links, avatar and focus rings

background.description: Page background colour (both modes unless backgroundDark is set)

backgroundDark.description: Page background colour in dark mode

backgroundImage.description: Same forms as an app icon; covers the page. Used in both modes unless backgroundImageDark is set

logo.description: Shown before the title. Same forms as an app icon

favicon.description: Browser tab icon. Same forms as an app icon

customCSS.description: Extra CSS appended after the built-in styles

id.description: Stable id for favourites. Default: slug of name

loginURL.description: Where the tile links instead of url, e.g. the app's SSO start. A path starting with / is resolved against url.

icon.description: https://… URL, di:<name> for dashboard-icons, or a file name in TILEGATE_ICONS_DIR. Empty shows the app's initial.

description.description: Tooltip text; also matched by search.

roles.description: Users holding any of these roles/groups see the app. Omit to show it to every signed-in user.

claim.description: Claim path to read roles from for this app only, overriding TILEGATE_ROLES_CLAIM.

newTab.description: Open in a new browser tab.
